name: DailyFixer
subtitle: Planner with reminders, missions and Google Drive sync

apps.name: DailyFixer
apps.subtitle: Plan your day. Fix what matters.
apps.localizedDescription: Tasks, reminders, goals and missions. Works offline; syncs through your own Google Drive.

versions.localizedDescription: Tasks that work offline: add a task, tick it off, swipe to delete. Everything is saved on the device first. Mac: one-line install from Terminal into your Applications folder, a DMG for those who prefer it, and updates inside the app (DailyFixer → Check for Updates…), each one checked against our signing key. iPhone and iPad: install and update through SideStore with your own Apple ID (free); our source lists every new version. Google Drive sync (built in, switched on in a later build): each task becomes a small file in DailyFixer's hidden folder in your Drive; the app can't see anything else there. Sign-in appears in Settings once our Google sign-in is set up.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: DailyFixer shows your calendar events next to your tasks.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DailyFixer listens when you dictate a task.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DailyFixer turns what you say into a task.
